description: This file declares interfaces for interacting with the MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter chip. It includes function prototypes for initialization and reading values, and includes dependencies related to hardware and global configurations.

methods.name: initMax31855
methods.description: Initializes the MAX31855 device with a shared logger, SPI driver, and chip select array, conditional on SPI support.

methods.name: getEgtValue
methods.description: Retrieves a temperature or voltage reading from the specified EGT (Exhaust Gas Temperature) channel.
